# FORGE

Local-first Life OS with a personal coach for morning execution, clean living, and personal progression.

## Documentation

- README: /README.md
- Contributing: /CONTRIBUTING.md
- Security: /SECURITY.md
- Protocol: /docs/PROTOCOL.md
- Operator guide: /docs/OPERATOR.md

## Module Map

### Morning Execution
- Morning ritual logic: /src/lib/morning.ts
- Morning UI: /src/components/MorningView.tsx
- Coach intelligence: /src/lib/coach.ts

### Habits (Clean Living)
- Clean quests UI: /src/components/CleanView.tsx
- Quest tracking: /src/components/TodayView.tsx

### Training & Skills
- Skills tracking: /src/components/SkillsView.tsx
- Skill builder: /src/components/SkillBuilder.tsx
- Quest builder: /src/components/QuestBuilder.tsx
- Progression system: /src/lib/progression.ts

### Focus
- Focus UI: /src/components/FocusView.tsx
- Review system: /src/components/ReviewView.tsx
